definition: a heavy load or worry you must carry
description: Steep whitewashed steps in a sunny island village with blue doors, pink flowers and blue domes. A young man in a white shirt and beige shorts staggers under a huge pile of backpacks, duffel bags and a guitar case, an olive bag hanging at his side and a blue cool box in his hand. The pile wobbles and nearly slips as he struggles to hold it, his face strained. Up the steps his friends walk away from him, one carrying a crate of lemons, a woman sweeps by a door and a cat lies on a step.

taps.phrase: to carry a crate of lemons
to stretch out on a step
